name: Repositories
description: Bar menu of every git repository under one directory (dots.repos): branch, ahead/behind the upstream, changed paths, unmerged branches and worktrees, checked only when the menu opens. A row opens to its branches and worktrees and the actions: fetch, open the directory, a terminal there, delete a merged branch, remove a clean worktree. Commands come from the plugin settings (dots: modules/home/dank/repos-menu.nix).
author: dots
